summary:
In national governance and administration, the Himachal Pradesh government achieved a record 47.1% revenue share in the e-auction of the heritage property Wildflower Hall. In municipal administration, the Kolkata Municipal Corporation (KMC) enhanced administrative decentralization by authorizing assistant commissioners to sanction municipal expenditures up to ₹10 lakh. Meanwhile, the Brihanmumbai Electric Supply and Transport (BEST) approved a ₹33,000 Diwali ex-gratia bonus per employee, adding a ₹75 crore financial burden to the public transport undertaking. Additionally, the Odisha Chief Minister conducted an aerial assessment of flood-affected districts to accelerate disaster relief distribution.

On the legal and environmental front, West Bengal stipulated a strict two-hour window (8 PM to 10 PM) exclusively for certified green crackers during Kali Puja on November 8, under the monitoring of the West Bengal Pollution Control Board and police. In law enforcement and cyber regulations, Hyderabad police invoked Section 79 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) along with Section 67 of the Information Technology Act to address online harassment. Concurrently, the Income Tax Department initiated search and survey operations across nine premises of Omega Hospitals in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh over alleged income suppression.

In international business and technology markets, global semiconductor equities experienced heavy volatility, led by a 30% plunge in Intel alongside steep declines in AMD, Nvidia, and Broadcom driven by weak revenue forecasts and shifting supply dynamics. Internationally, Snap faces independent legal scrutiny in a Los Angeles court over allegations concerning the impact of social media algorithms on adolescent mental health.
keyFacts: Himachal Pradesh secured a record 47.1% revenue share in the e-auction of Wildflower Hall.
Kolkata Municipal Corporation empowered assistant commissioners to sanction expenditure up to ₹10 lakh.
BEST approved a Diwali ex-gratia payment of ₹33,000 per employee, resulting in an additional ₹75 crore liability.
West Bengal mandated an 8 PM–10 PM window exclusively for certified green crackers during Kali Puja.
Hyderabad police invoked BNS Section 79 and IT Act Section 67 in an online harassment case.
Income Tax Department surveyed 9 premises of Omega Hospitals across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
Intel plunged 30% and AMD dropped 12% amid a wider rout in global semiconductor stocks.

mcqs.question: What record percentage of revenue share did the Himachal Pradesh government secure in the e-auction of the heritage property Wildflower Hall?
mcqs.explanation: The Himachal Pradesh government achieved a record 47.1% revenue share in the e-auction of the heritage property Wildflower Hall. This marks a significant milestone in national governance and public asset leasing.

mcqs.question: The heritage property 'Wildflower Hall', which was recently in the news regarding an e-auction for revenue sharing, is located in which State/UT?
mcqs.explanation: Wildflower Hall is a prominent heritage property situated in Himachal Pradesh. The state government recently concluded an e-auction securing a record revenue share.

mcqs.question: To enhance administrative decentralization, the Kolkata Municipal Corporation (KMC) has authorized assistant commissioners to sanction municipal expenditures up to what financial limit?
mcqs.explanation: Kolkata Municipal Corporation empowered assistant commissioners to sanction municipal expenditures up to ₹10 lakh. This move aims to decentralize administrative processes and expedite local development projects.

mcqs.question: Which municipal corporation recently decentralized administrative powers by allowing its assistant commissioners to sanction expenditures up to ₹10 lakh?
mcqs.explanation: The Kolkata Municipal Corporation (KMC) initiated this administrative decentralization measure. It delegates spending approval powers of up to ₹10 lakh to assistant commissioners.

mcqs.question: The Brihanmumbai Electric Supply and Transport (BEST) approved a Diwali ex-gratia bonus of what amount per employee?
mcqs.explanation: BEST approved an ex-gratia payment of ₹33,000 per employee ahead of Diwali. This sanction introduces an additional ₹75 crore financial commitment for the undertaking.

mcqs.question: What is the total estimated financial liability added to the Brihanmumbai Electric Supply and Transport (BEST) following the approval of the Diwali ex-gratia bonus?
mcqs.explanation: The approved ₹33,000 Diwali ex-gratia bonus per employee adds an estimated ₹75 crore financial burden to BEST. BEST is the civic transport and electricity provider for Mumbai.

mcqs.question: The Chief Minister of which state recently conducted an aerial assessment of flood-affected districts to accelerate disaster relief operations?
mcqs.explanation: The Chief Minister of Odisha conducted an aerial assessment of flood-affected regions to expedite relief distribution. Timely disaster management interventions were prioritized following the assessment.

mcqs.question: Under the environmental regulations stipulated in West Bengal for Kali Puja, what is the permitted time window for bursting certified green crackers?
mcqs.explanation: West Bengal mandated a strict two-hour window between 8 PM and 10 PM exclusively for certified green crackers. The implementation is monitored jointly by the state pollution control board and police.

mcqs.question: Which authority alongside the state police has been tasked with enforcing the green cracker compliance window in West Bengal?
mcqs.explanation: The West Bengal Pollution Control Board, in coordination with the police, is responsible for enforcing the cracker regulations. The monitoring ensures only certified green crackers are used within the prescribed hours.

mcqs.question: Hyderabad police invoked which Section of the newly enacted Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) along with Section 67 of the IT Act to tackle online harassment?
mcqs.explanation: Hyderabad police invoked Section 79 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) in conjunction with Section 67 of the Information Technology Act. This action was taken to address an online harassment case.

mcqs.question: In a recent cyber harassment case registered by the Hyderabad police, Section 79 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) was applied alongside which provision of the Information Technology Act?
mcqs.explanation: The police invoked Section 67 of the Information Technology Act alongside Section 79 of the BNS. Section 67 pertains to the publication or transmission of obscene material in electronic form.

mcqs.question: The Income Tax Department conducted search and survey operations across nine premises of Omega Hospitals located in which two states?
mcqs.explanation: The Income Tax Department initiated search and survey operations across 9 premises of Omega Hospitals in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. The action was undertaken following allegations of income suppression.

mcqs.question: Which global technology corporation experienced a steep 30% drop in share price amid a wider market rout in semiconductor stocks?
mcqs.explanation: Intel saw its shares plunge by 30% following weak revenue forecasts and industry headwinds. This decline triggered broad volatility across the global semiconductor sector.

mcqs.question: Along with Intel, which other major semiconductor firm registered a notable 12% decline amid volatile global tech trading?
mcqs.explanation: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) dropped 12% as part of the broader selloff in semiconductor equities. Weak forecasts and changing supply dynamics contributed to the market contraction.

mcqs.question: Which social media parent company is facing independent legal scrutiny in a Los Angeles court over the impact of its algorithms on adolescent mental health?
mcqs.explanation: Snap is facing legal scrutiny in a Los Angeles court regarding the psychological impact of its social media algorithms on teenagers. The case examines platform design choices affecting adolescent well-being.
